headline: A two-year lag behind a national trend

items.title: Massachusetts: still 'may issue'
items.detail: A handgun (LTC) required the local licensing authority's sign-off, usually the police chief or a designee.

items.title: Bruen forces MA to 'shall issue'
items.detail: U.S. Supreme Court strikes down discretionary licensing.

note: Rifles (FID) were already close to automatic; the bottleneck was handgun-specific.
